name: Sierra Vista Plaza
demographics: Sierra Vista Plaza serves the growing Murrieta community in Southwest Riverside County, attracting primarily middle-income families and young professionals with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $125,000. The trade area draws from Murrieta's diverse population, including a significant percentage of families with children and homeowners aged 30-55 who prioritize convenience shopping. The center caters to daily needs shoppers seeking grocery, services, and quick-service dining options typical of suburban community centers in this rapidly developing region of Southern California.
description: Sierra Vista Plaza is a well-established community shopping center located on Hancock Avenue in Murrieta, California, serving the thriving Southwest Riverside County market. Managed by Phillips Edison & Company, a nationally recognized shopping center REIT specializing in grocery-anchored retail properties, the plaza has become a neighborhood staple for residents seeking convenient access to everyday essentials and services. The center maintains strong community ties and benefits from Murrieta's continued population growth and economic development. With operating hours from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily, Sierra Vista Plaza provides accessible shopping for busy families and professionals throughout the week. The property has earned a solid 4.3-star rating from 347 customer reviews, reflecting its consistent service and tenant mix that meets the daily needs of the local community.
summary: Sierra Vista Plaza is a community shopping center in Murrieta, California, managed by Phillips Edison & Company. The center serves as a convenient neighborhood destination with a 4.3-star rating, offering daily essentials and services to the growing Southwest Riverside County market.
